newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN P-NOTES - Tenders total A$55 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN P-NOTES - Tenders total A$55 mln.

text.p: The Australian commercial paper issuance totals crept up on Tuesday to a total of A$55 million sold via tender.
Keystart Bonds sold A$25 million early January-dated promissory notes at 6.86 percent.
Their 9.5 basis point margin over the corresponding BBSW mid-rate was due to the bill market rallying hard after the close of the tender, dealers said.
Short end debt players were confused about the reaction of the market to inaction from the Reserve Bank of Australia board meeting this morning.
There had been some speculation in the lead up to the meeting that the RBA may cut rates Wednesday, although this was seen as unlikely.
"It was a perverse reaction this morning. The bills were well bid before (the RBA's usual 2330 GMT (9.30 a.m.) announcement time) and even better bid after," one Melbourne-based dealer said.
